title: Overpriced and Not Effective
text: Overpriced and Not Effective. These mop heads are fairly well-made, but they're too expansive for what you're getting, and they are not very convenient to use - results aren't great either.

【Vacuum and Mop in One Stroke】 - Our motorhead makes your stick vacuum do wet cleaning too, combining vacuuming and mopping to quickly clean daily messes.
【Reusable and Washable Mop Pads】 - Made of nanoscale nylon cloth, our washable mop pads are effective at collecting dust and water without leaving stains, streaks, or marks on the floor.
